subject: Tidecrest site-visit: compressed travel window — propose hybrid alternative
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tidecrest.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@tidecrest.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tidecrest demo — travel window update

Hi Karthik,

Quick heads-up: our field team had an unexpected scheduling change. The site visit that was meant to give us an hour for your full demo on Aug 20 got compressed into a half-day on Aug 19–20. The only solid time the decision-makers are available in person is the afternoon of Aug 24, but they will be on the move between meetings earlier in the week.

Would you be open to one of these options?
- Keep a short live session on Aug 20 but reduce to 20–25 mins (we'd miss some attendees)
- Move to Aug 24 afternoon (preferred) for the full audience
- Or record a 15–20 min focused demo (core flows) and follow with a 30 min live Q&A at a time that works for the team

We really want to see the workflow end-to-end but are flexible on format given travel. If you have an outline for a shorter recording + live Q&A, please send it over.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Clinical Ops
Tidecrest Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tidecrest.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tidecrest demo — travel window update

Samir — thanks for the update and the options.

Short answer: yes, we can do the hybrid approach and it’s probably the safest given the tight on-site windows. Proposal:
- We produce a ~15 minute polished recording that walks the core patient intake -> model inference -> routing flows (deliverable attached: Tidecrest_session_outline.pdf)
- Schedule a 30–45 minute live Q&A session with decision-makers (Aug 24 15:00–15:45 PT proposed) to cover integrations and SLAs
- Lauren will attend in case any on-site details need to be discussed; Priyom will run the recording logistics and deliver the recording 48 hours before the Q&A

If that works I’ll send an updated calendar invite (hybrid link + on-site dial-in) and a short doc with talking points. If you’d still prefer a compressed live demo on Aug 20 we can do a ~25 minute live session but recommend recording it so others can watch later.

Attachment: alternative_session_plan.docx

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@tidecrest.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@tidecrest.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tidecrest demo — travel window update

Thanks — Aug 24, 15:00–15:45 PT works for the group. Appreciate the flexibility on the recording. Two quick asks:
1) Can you share the short recording at least 48 hours before so our legal and IT can spot-check any questions in advance?
2) Please include the basic integration diagram and data flow in the deck (we’ll need that for our security team).

We’re fine converting the original Aug 20 calendar entry to the hybrid invite. The on-site lead will still try to attend the live Q&A but may be moving between rooms — hence the recording is important.

Thanks,
Elaine Wu
Executive Assistant, Tidecrest Health
[Attachment: Tidecrest_session_outline.pdf (PDF)]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tidecrest demo — travel window update

Perfect — I’ll mark Aug 24, 15:00–15:45 PT on my calendar as the on-site backup and will coordinate room logistics if they want to join from the tour floor. Priyom — can you confirm you can deliver the recording by Aug 22 EOD so Elaine can share it with legal/IT? Also, please include a one-slide integration diagram in the recording or as a companion PDF.

Karthik — I’ll wait for your updated invite (with hybrid link) and will be on standby to fill any gaps if the on-site attendee gets pulled.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
